_note: SYNTHETIC wording excerpts, one record per clause per endorsement version. Only the FLOOD clauses differ between 2023 and 2025 (the 2025 wording is longer and reads 'better' for flood queries — that is the trap). H-6.1 exists only in 2023; H-7.1 and M-3.6 only in 2025. Wording text is quoted verbatim in triage output; it is the only place the word 'covered' may appear.

chunks.title: Fire and explosion
chunks.text: We insure the buildings and contents against loss or damage caused by fire, lightning or explosion, up to the fire sub-limit in the Schedule, less the standard deductible.

chunks.title: Theft
chunks.text: We insure contents against theft or attempted theft involving forcible and violent entry to the home, up to the theft sub-limit in the Schedule. Theft by a person lawfully in the home is excluded.

chunks.title: Storm and wind
chunks.text: We insure damage to the buildings caused by storm, wind or hail, up to the storm sub-limit in the Schedule. Damage to fences, gates and hedges is dealt with in clause H-6.1.

chunks.title: Storm and wind
chunks.text: We insure damage to the buildings caused by storm, wind or hail, up to the storm sub-limit in the Schedule.

chunks.title: Flood
chunks.text: We insure loss or damage to the buildings and contents caused by flood, meaning water entering the home from an overflowing river or from surface water, subject to the flood sub-limit and the flood deductible in the Schedule.

chunks.title: Flood exclusion
chunks.text: FLOOD EXCLUSION. We do not insure loss or damage caused by flood, flooding, storm surge, overflowing river, surface water or rising groundwater entering the home, whether or not driven by a storm, unless the Flood Extension endorsement FE-2025 is shown in the Schedule. Where FE-2025 applies, the flood sub-limit and the flood deductible in the Schedule apply to the flood claim.

chunks.title: Escape of water
chunks.text: We insure loss or damage caused by the sudden escape of water from a fixed tank, pipe or domestic appliance, up to the escape of water sub-limit in the Schedule. Water that enters the home from outside is not an escape of water.

chunks.title: General exclusions
chunks.text: We do not insure wear and tear, gradual deterioration, defective workmanship, loss caused by war, or loss caused deliberately by the insured.

chunks.title: Garden fences and gates
chunks.text: We insure fences, gates and hedges against damage caused by storm, up to the storm sub-limit in the Schedule.

chunks.title: Wildfire and bushfire
chunks.text: We insure the buildings and contents against loss or damage caused by wildfire or bushfire, up to the fire sub-limit in the Schedule. A defensible-space inspection may be required before the claim is assessed.

chunks.title: Collision
chunks.text: We insure damage to your vehicle caused by collision with another vehicle, object or animal, up to the collision sub-limit in the Schedule, less the standard deductible.

chunks.title: Windscreen

chunks.title: Flood and water damage
chunks.text: We insure damage to your vehicle caused by flood or by water entering the vehicle, up to the flood sub-limit in the Schedule, less the flood deductible.

chunks.title: Flood exclusion
chunks.text: FLOOD EXCLUSION. We do not insure damage caused by flood, flooding, standing water or water entering the vehicle where the vehicle was driven into or parked in flood water or in an area subject to a flood warning, unless Flood Extension FE-2025 is shown in the Schedule. Where FE-2025 applies, the flood sub-limit and the flood deductible in the Schedule apply.
